covers.prompt: Original square record sleeve, edge-to-edge flat abstract graphic design. Clear lava-lamp / molten paraffin wax theme. Asymmetric organic forms, bold shape hierarchy, negative space, simple readable type; tactile grain, uneven printed ink, 2-4 colors. No photorealism, glossy 3D, perfect symmetry, fantasy scenery, flowers/moons/houses, brands, borrowed album designs, existing artists, or watermarks. Print only the exact invented artist and album names below. A quiet abstract ambient sleeve with lots of pale paper space. Three-color risograph palette: warm ivory paper, misty sage, muted coral. Two large asymmetric soft-edged molten-wax shapes almost merge along an off-center vertical current, one long upward droplet separates at the top. A very subtle limited-ink gradient runs only within the blobs, visibly granular and printed, not a smooth computer glow. A delicate incomplete tapered lamp contour in sage encloses the shapes without dominating. Calm negative space with simple small but readable lowercase sans-serif typography: "wax and wane" along the upper-left margin and "suspended melt" near the lower-right margin. No moons, flowers, spheres, realistic glass or landscapes. Tactile ink on paper, restrained and intentional.
